changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE no_declaration RENAME TO declaration;

changeSet.author: KJ
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE grade_item ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, gradeitem_id BIGINT NOT NULL, course_id BIGINT NOT NULL, user_id BIGINT NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, item_name TEXT, item_type TEXT NOT NULL, item_module TEXT, grade DOUBLE PRECISION, CONSTRAINT fk_grade_item_user FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES "user"(id) ON DELETE CASCADE );

changeSet.author: KJ
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE inactive ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, user_id BIGINT NOT NULL, date_time TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CONSTRAINT fk_inactive_user_id FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES "user"(id) ON DELETE CASCADE );
